title: Ben Bukhri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the time of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. He is mentioned in Shekalim ch. 1, mishnah 4: Rabbi Yehudah said, Ben Bokhri testified at Yavneh: any kohen who pays the shekel does not sin. Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai said to him: No, etc. And in the Mishnah of the Westerners (Palestinian version) the reading is "Ben Kovri"; and this is the reading of the Arukh and of Yuchasin.
